description: Ledger product screens for /software/ledger (plan 2026-11-04, section 5.3). Local demo with synthetic data only (Musterfirma Digital GmbH, scripts/seed-demo.mjs on branch demo-seed) on http://localhost:3200, signed in as the Buchhaltung-role user; see var/research/ledger-demo.md. Capture with Build/Scripts/capture-app-screenshots.mjs --base http://localhost:3200 --shots <this file> --state <signed-in storage state> (or --login with APP_USERNAME / APP_PASSWORD in the environment). The invoice shot reads a static page on http://127.0.0.1:8766 that shows a sent demo invoice rendered as PNG. Never press 'Rechnung aus Auswahl', 'Automatisch abgleichen' or any Redmine/Drive/Gmail button.

steps.evaluate: (() => { const hit = [...document.querySelectorAll('main *')].find((e) => e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === 'Storno-Verweis'); let box = hit; while (box && box.parentElement && box.parentElement.querySelector('input') === null) box = box.parentElement; (box?.parentElement ?? box)?.remove(); })()
(() => { const hit = [...document.querySelectorAll('main p, main div')].find((e) => e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.includes('Gmail-Label')); hit?.remove(); })()

(() => { const hit = [...document.querySelectorAll('main *')].find((e) => e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === 'Noch keine Bank verbunden'); let box = hit; while (box && box.parentElement && !box.parentElement.matches('main, section, form') && box.parentElement.textContent.trim().startsWith('Noch keine Bank verbunden')) box = box.parentElement; box?.remove(); })()
